verdict.rationale: Quo ships a built-in AI agent, Sona, which the team can rely on to answer calls when they cannot, capture details, and hand conversations back, and the API documents summaries for calls handled by Sona. That makes Sona a real in-product AI that takes over a delegated task. However, it is scoped to call answering and intake, not a general assistant users can hand arbitrary tasks to. The Claude/ChatGPT connectors and the MCP server rely on external agents, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product assistant accepting user-issued tasks, documentation of how users configure or delegate to Sona, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Sona answers when your team can't, captures the details you need, and hands the conversation to your team when it matters.
This endpoint supports summaries for both regular calls and calls handled by Sona.
